title: PPMI Randomized Disclosure Assessment in the Parkinson's At-Risk Cohort: The RaDAR Study
author: Thomas Tropea

steps.title: Recruit and Screen Participants
steps.instruction: Identify and invite eligible participants from the PPMI Clinical study prodromal cohort (individuals with genetic risk variants, REM sleep behavior disorder, and/or hyposmia).

substeps.instruction: Verify participants are actively enrolled in the PPMI 002 Clinical study prodromal cohort in the United States.
Ensure participants are registered users of the myPPMI platform.
Send invitations via email and the myPPMI 'opportunity tile' (button), or discuss the study via site study staff.

steps.title: Obtain Informed Consent
steps.instruction: Facilitate the electronic consent process through the myPPMI portal.

substeps.instruction: Provide participants with information regarding the return of research information and the RaDAR study via the opportunity tile.
Obtain electronic informed consent from interested individuals.
Allow participants to save a digital copy of the signed informed consent documentation.

steps.title: Randomize Participants
steps.instruction: Assign consented participants to either the immediate or delayed disclosure group, stratifying by age and sex.

substeps.instruction: Randomize participants based on age (below 65 vs. 65 and above) and sex (self-reported male vs. female).
Inform participants of their group assignment within the myPPMI platform.

steps.title: Provide Educational Materials
steps.instruction: Grant all randomized participants access to educational materials regarding research information disclosure and specific information types.

substeps.instruction: Provide materials covering DaTscan imaging, MDS-UPDRS Part III, and aSyn SAA.
Ensure materials are available at the time of randomization and again at the time of disclosure (for the delayed group), or accessible at any time.

steps.title: Execute Disclosure Process
steps.instruction: Manage the release of personal research information based on the randomized group assignment.

substeps.instruction: Immediate Disclosure Group: Provide access to available baseline and longitudinal research information immediately.
Delayed Disclosure Group: Withhold personal research information for 2 years after enrollment.

Handle 'Early Access' requests: Allow participants in the delayed arm to re-assign themselves to the immediate group to access information early, provided they agree to continue completing study surveys for the full 2 years.

steps.title: Collect Study Outcomes and Surveys
steps.instruction: Gather participant-completed and investigator-completed data at specified intervals.

substeps.instruction: Administer myPPMI surveys at Baseline (prior to randomization), 6 weeks, 1 year, and 2 years after enrollment.
Collect Participant-completed Primary outcomes: High Interest Questionnaire, Concerns for PD Scale, HELP Screener, and Future Time Perspective questionnaire.

Collect Participant-completed Secondary outcomes: MDS-UPDRS Part Ib and Part II, Geriatric Depression Scale (GDS), State-Trait Anxiety Inventory (STAI), and Quality of Life in Neurological Disorders (Neuro QoL).
Collect Investigator-completed Secondary outcomes: MDS-UPDRS Part III motor score, Schwab and England ADL, and global impression outcomes.
Require participants who choose to receive their results to complete post-disclosure surveys.
